tasks.label: ci
args: npm ci && exec npm run ci

tasks.label: dev-preview
args:
export DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE=true DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES=true DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_LOGIN=true DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_ORGANISER_EMAILS="${DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_ORGANISER_EMAILS:-demo-organiser@example.invalid}"; _created_dev_vars=false; if [ ! -e .dev.vars ]; then printf 'DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE=%s
DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES=%s
DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_LOGIN=%s
DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_ORGANISER_EMAILS=%s
DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_LOCAL_PREVIEW_HOST=%s
' "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE" "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES" "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_LOGIN" "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_DEMO_ORGANISER_EMAILS" "${DGHK_PREVIEW_HOST:-}" > .dev.vars; for _feature_binding in DGHK_FEATURE_FAMILY_PREFERENCES_FAMILY_ROOM_WISHES DGHK_FEATURE_FAMILY_PREFERENCES_ORGANISER_ROOM_WISHES DGHK_FEATURE_WORKSHOP_RANKINGS_FAMILY_WORKSHOP_WISHES DGHK_FEATURE_WORKSHOP_RANKINGS_ORGANISER_WORKSHOP_WISHES; do eval "_feature_value=\${$_feature_binding:-}"; if [ -n "$_feature_value" ]; then printf '%s=%s
' "$_feature_binding" "$_feature_value" >> .dev.vars; fi; done; _created_dev_vars=true; fi; trap '[ "$_created_dev_vars" = true ] && rm -f .dev.vars' EXIT; npm ci && env CI=1 npm run dev

tasks.label: storybook
args: npm ci && exec npm run storybook -- --host "${DGHK_STORYBOOK_BIND:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${DGHK_STORYBOOK_PORT:-6006}"
